source.text: A case with one fault: a kernel radius distribution truncated to a range that keeps under 1 % of its draws. FEED must refuse it before any run; SEED reports E_POPULATION_UNSAMPLABLE.
source.check: FEED's schema vectors (schema/vectors/bad/triso-population-truncation-cannot-be-sampled.json) assert the same code in FEED's own test suite.
